header:
# Jay municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 12; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Jay's three selectboard members as Tara Morse, David Sanders, and Le-Ann Tetrault (Chair)

Town of Jay, minutes of the annual town meeting, March 3, 2026 (official town website): Le-Ann Tetrault was re-elected to a three-year selectboard term at the 2026 meeting; Morse and Sanders hold over
Town of Jay, minutes of the annual town meeting, March 3, 2026 (official town website): Janet Butler was re-elected moderator for a one-year term at the 2026 meeting, which she chaired
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lynnette Deaette as Jay's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Lynnette Deaette as Jay's town clerk contact
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Lynnette Deaette as Jay's town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Lynnette Deaette as Jay's town treasurer contact

Town of Jay, 2025 Book (official town website), Warning for the March 3, 2026 annual meeting, Article 3: the meeting elects 'all necessary town officials required by law,' specifying only a selectboard member (three years) and a constable (one year)

Town of Jay, minutes of the annual town meeting, March 3, 2026 (official town website): Dorran Dougherty was elected constable for a one-year term at the 2026 meeting. The warning and minutes are Jay's comprehensive elective list for 2026: no lister (the town employs a hired assessor), auditor, grand juror, town agent, or collector of delinquent taxes was elected, so no posts are created for those offices

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names five justices of the peace for Jay: Arnold Cota Jr, Hailey Morse, Elizabeth Sargent, Benjamin Zev, and Le-Ann Tetrault
